workoutSnapshot.name: Friday To Black
workoutSnapshot.purpose: Strength and conditioning followed by a four-minute circuit. Record seven working weights, final Floor Press set repetitions per arm and complete finisher rounds only.

warmup.note: Warm-up, cooldown and initial 3-2-1 countdown are outside the 20-minute workout.

exercises.name: KB Alternating Floor Press
exercises.note: Use ONE kettlebell. Alternate arms with controlled technique within the 40-second work period. Fourth Floor Press working set: 06:00–06:40, followed by rest until 07:00 (full slot 06:00–07:00). Count actual repetitions for each arm separately, not totals across all four sets.

exercises.name: KB Sumo Deadlift
exercises.note: Move with controlled technique for 40 seconds, then rest for the full 20 seconds. Repetition ranges are optional guidance.

exercises.name: KB Staggered-Stance Row
exercises.note: Work both sides evenly within 40 seconds; 20 seconds per side is guidance, not an extra timer segment.

exercises.name: KB Sit-Up + Twist
exercises.note: Alternate twist directions evenly during the 40-second work interval.

exercises.name: KB Front Rack March
exercises.note: Work both holding sides evenly within 40 seconds; 20 seconds per side is guidance. Switch manually without adding time.

exercises.name: KB Chest-Level Crossover
exercises.note: Work both sides evenly within the 40-second interval.

exercises.name: KB Goblet Squat + Curl
exercises.note: Use ONE kettlebell. One complete squat-plus-curl combination counts as one repetition.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.note: One knee drive counts as one repetition. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.note: Each fully completed burpee counts as one repetition.
